text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Sakura Laurel conquered the Japanese 
Derby. Her legs were safe, having managed 
to pull back before anything serious 
happened—all to connect to the future 
ahead.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Narita Brian was indeed strong. And Sakura 
Laurel is certain she will become even 
stronger. By the time of the Kikuka Sho... 
stronger still.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She wants to beat Narita Brian. —No more 
hesitation. Sakura Laurel begins taking 
straightforward strides toward her idol.
